# `approx_count_distinct`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
approx_count_distinct(expr[, relativeSD])
```

Returns the estimated cardinality by HyperLogLog++.
`relativeSD` defines the maximum relative standard deviation allowed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- approx_count_distinct, example 1
> SELECT approx_count_distinct(col1) FROM VALUES (1), (1), (2), (2), (3) tab(col1);
3
```
